text:
leo: FYI smoke failing for nova-17b in dedicated canary. tokenizer error during embed lookup.
maria: ugh, paste the trace?
leo: ```
IndexError: index 50256 is out of bounds for axis 0 with size 50200
  File \"/opt/runtime/tokenizer.py\", line 142, in encode
    return np.take(self.vocab_embeddings, token_ids, axis=0)
``` 
aj: that usually means vocab_size in config != actual tokenizer vocab. did we accidentally truncate merges or add special tokens?
maria: where are the weights + tokenizer coming from for this build? path please.
leo: s3://models/redwood/nova-17b/v1/weights.pt and s3://models/redwood/nova-17b/v1/tokenizer.json (uploaded yesterday by @sam)
chen: quick check — open the tokenizer.json and model_config.json, confirm `vocab_size`, `bos_token_id` and any `added_tokens`. also check embedding weight shape: (50200, 4096) vs config.vocab_size
sam: I grabbed the tokenizers from the community repo; they had a 56-token special set appended locally. weights were from the upstream but not re-expanded. my bad, prepping a fix.
maria: alternate workaround: if we set tokenizer to map OOB ids to <unk> (id 0) until weights are re-exported, can keep canary up.
aj: also flag: runtime supports GQA and MQA options for this arch. if embeddings mismatch we might also hit kv cache indexing later. check model_config flags: `qgroup` and `use_mqa`.
chen: there was a subtle RoPE scaling mismatch too on earlier runs — config had `rotary_base: 10000` but model was trained with scaled RoPE (scale=1.125). if token indices shift with added tokens, attention relative positions can break. recommend validating `rotary_scale` param.
leo: good call. how do we validate quickly?
aj: run the small serve smoke with explicit checks:
```
# local
python -m runtime.tests.serve_smoke --model-path s3://models/redwood/nova-17b/v1 --check-config --max-tokens 32
```
It will compare tokenizer.vocab_size vs embedding.shape and check `rotary_scale` present.
sam: opened PR 3245 with a script to expand embedding matrix and to remap added token ids -> appended rows (placeholder zeroed). link: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/3245
maria: can you also add a config lint rule to fail CI early if tokenizer.json.vocab_size != embedding.shape[0] ?
sam: yep adding now.
chen: on the RoPE piece — if we can't reproduce training scale precisely we should default to `rotary_scale: auto` which picks the per-layer scale based on positional stats. that avoids hard-failing but we should surface a warning in logs.
leo: @aj can you review the PR? need a quick +1 to merge and push canary.
aj: will take a look in 30m. main thing: ensure `use_mqa` not toggled accidentally — we need to preserve grouping from weights or QKV shapes mismatch.
infra-bot: Canary deploy triggered for nova-17b with image runtime:canary-20260312-8a2f — monitoring logs.
sam: after PR merges i'll reupload a fixed tokenizer and expanded embeddings to s3 and re-run the smoke.
maria: who owns follow-up to add the CI lint and warning? assignable issue?
leo: i'll own follow-up tracking. I created issue #789 in backlog.
sam: pushed small change to PR: added CI check and a unit test for OOB token remap.
aj: quick note — sliding-window chunking tests also need a run because added tokens change chunk boundaries; run `tests/chunking/test_sliding_window.py` in CI for this model set.
chen: acknowledged, will queue that test in the canary suite.
leo: ok thanks all. plan: AJ reviews PR, SAM merges + reupload, CHEN enqueues sliding-window run, MARIA watches canary metrics. ping here when done :thumbsup:
sam: will update thread when uploads complete.
infra-bot: Canary logs: initial embed-lookup errors suppressed after placeholder-expansion, but latency + cache-miss rate rose ~8% — continuing monitoring.
